questions.question: Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow. Social media, which was created to bring the world closer virtually, has in fact resulted in an addictive phenomenon which has led to an increase in the number of anxiety and depression-related cases. ‘Social detox’ is an up and coming term, which refers to a social blackout for a certain number of days, to essentially give the mind and soul a rest from the constant updates. However, with the world that we live in, this isn’t the ideal answer to our problems. A ‘social detox’ may not be viable given the work and priorities we all have. An alternative to aid our mental health and have an overall positive impact on our mood is music. Music is a universal language that is understood and felt across cultures, religions and all social aspects. Every element in the universe actually originates from a sound vibration. Simple elements of nature like the rustle of trees, the crunching of grass and bees buzzing have a calming effect on the brain and have the power of inducing a sense of happiness and joy. A great example of the power of music to induce a remedial melody for a stress-filled mind is the lullabies which were sung by our mothers at a very young age. It is observed that singing lullabies to children calms them, putting them to a peaceful sleep. Similarly, playing music while working can not only increase one's productivity but also act as a breather amidst an otherwise stressful environment. Music is also seen as a great medium to practice meditation – the epitome of achieving mental peace. All these examples exhibit the effect of music on one's mental health by stimulating a calming sensation. In olden times, music was given equal importance as maths and other subjects because it was known to aid the cognitive development of children. Playing an instrument is the brain's equivalent of a full body work out, as it engages all parts of the brain at once, especially the visual, motor and auditory cortices. Music and its positive effects on the mind have been studied by various professionals, which has led to the introduction of music therapy. Music is also a readily available medium that can help individuals of all age groups battle mental health problems. Select the most appropriate title for the passage.

questions.question: Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow. Pinki Chauhan, a 19-year-old college girl has become a household name across UP’s Deoria district for her ‘Pinki ki Pathsala’ – an informal class, about the dreaded kala-azar disease, she takes in government schools. Pinki is a kala azar survivor. She caught the ‘black disease’ in 2015 when she was 12, and the pain is all that she remembers now. She recovered from the disease but a year later Kala Azar’s sequential infection – post kala-azar dermal leishmaniasis (PDKL) in which the parasite invades the skin – gripped her. Both times she ran from pillar to post for treatment and that led to a lot of suffering and wastage of money. While she defeated the infection, she realized that ignorance of the cause was almost universal and the treatment relatively simple. The deep impact on her mind made her resolve to fight against it. Her parents allowed her to take up the cause after completing Class 12. In 2021, Pinki got involved with the UP government’s community engagement effort to create awareness against kala-azar. With that, she gained a deeper understanding of the subject. In 2022, she began her campaign against the disease from her own college. Now, she visits other schools and also tries to reach out to at least 20 people every day. She interacts with housewives and does not hesitate to discuss the topic with men, like a well-trained health worker. She has been able to reach 10,000 schoolchildren and over 1,200 households. Though small, her contribution is significant considering that India has pledged to eliminate the disease from the country by the end of 2023. Her contribution to the fellow and society is really commendable. It will also inspire others to follow in her footsteps. According to the passage, which of the following statements is NOT true?
